name: Piojó (Colombia)
description: Horizontal bicolour of white and green, the green with a spiky sunburst rising into the white at the centre.
history: Municipal flag of Piojó, a municipality in the department of Atlántico, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: rising spiky sun on the dividing line
